subtitle.en: Vectors, systems of equations, matrices, determinants, vector spaces, eigenvalues, linear transformations and least squares — the proof-first foundation for multivariable calculus, engineering and computer science.

introText.en: Take Linear Algebra offline. The PDF packet prints straight from your browser; native Word versions with editable equation-editor math are available on request.
